name: Branded workwear & safety-recognition merchandise for Chicago-area trade contractors (promo distributor, supplier-decorated drop-ship)
summary: Founder-sold promotional-products distributorship focused on commercial trade contractors (electrical, plumbing, HVAC/mechanical, mid-size GCs) in Cook/DuPage/Kane/Lake/McHenry. Revenue = first 'crew kit' order per new account plus recurring reorders (new-hire kits, seasonal hi-vis/cold-weather gear, Safety Week/stand-down recognition, online company stores). No inventory; suppliers and contract decorators produce to order. Operating profit is before founder pay.
evidence_notes: Gross margin anchored on 4imprint H1-2026 gross margin 31.5% (B, C9-S015) and ASI's claimed 37% distributor average (C, WS16-S026); new-entrant base set at 31% because a newcomer has no volume rebates and prices against 4imprint's published end-buyer prices (B, DH-S025).

Repeat behaviour anchored on 4imprint: ~81% of H1-2026 orders came from existing customers (838k of 1,040k, our calc; B, DH-S026). Contractor-account annual spend ($7.8k base) and churn are analyst estimates (E).

Small distributors (<$1M sales) were roughly flat in Q2 2026 while >$1M firms grew ~4% (C, C9-S013); 4imprint new-customer orders fell 12% in 2025 (A, C9-S014). These argue against aggressive acquisition assumptions.

Membership/software costs are published: PPAI Standard Base $595/yr incl. 1 SAGE Workplace licence (B, DH-S020); commonsku $129/user/month, minimum 2 users (B, DH-S021). ASI membership price is not published (MISSING; D-level stale figures only, DH-S022).

Supplier credit: SanMar's credit application offers Net 30 or credit card, with credit report, trade references and a personal guaranty (B, DH-S024). New accounts are modelled as mostly card-prepaid (DPO 15 days base).
Customer terms: ASI 2023 survey reports corporate payment terms stretching to 'sometimes 120 days' (C, DH-S028). DSO 40 days base.
Rep economics: ASI 2023 median rep/manager compensation $75k; traditional 50/50 gross-profit split under pressure (C, DH-S028); commonsku estimates outside reps take ~40% of GP (D, DH-S029).
All funnel and volume drivers are E (no contact or test performed). Buyer universe: 1,266 contractors with >=5 Chicago permits of >=$100k reported cost in 2025-26 (A, DH-S031).

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: LLC + IDOR REG-1 registration (A, WS16-S036); PPAI join is online at $595/yr (B, DH-S020); supplier accounts need an industry number + resale certificate/credit app (C, DH-S023). 2-6 weeks (E).
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Stage A/C: orders 1-4 weeks, programs 1-3 months (E). First order usually follows a mockup/quote.
drivers.founder_ramp_months__source: Analyst estimate: list-building from permit data, sample kit, first referrals.
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified conversations with contractor ops/safety/office managers from ~15-20 hrs/week outbound + association events (MCA Chicago, ECA Chicago, Chicagoland AGC). Universe 1,266 permit-active contractors in Chicago alone (A, DH-S031).
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Analyst estimate: share of qualified conversations that request a quote/mockup.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Analyst estimate; incumbents (local shops, 4imprint, contractor's existing supplier) are entrenched; to be tested in validation experiment V2.
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Analyst estimate for one experienced industry rep; ASI 2023 notes 35% of reps on straight commission (C, DH-S028).
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Analyst estimate: GC-to-sub and union-local word of mouth.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: 26%/yr base account loss; 4imprint reports ~81% of orders from existing customers and 'strong and consistent retention' (B, DH-S026; C9-S014) - incumbent, so new-entrant churn set higher.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Active account reorders 4-8x/yr at ~$1,000-1,500 (=$5.4k-10.2k/yr). 4imprint AOV ~$654 (A, C9-S014, our calc) is a small-order floor; contractor orders are larger (crew quantities).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: First 'crew kit' order - see transaction T1 ($3,285) priced inside 4imprint published ranges (B, DH-S025); conservative assumes smaller trial orders.
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: 4imprint AOV +3% in H1-2026 via price adjustments (B, DH-S026); tariff pass-through.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: 4imprint H1-2026 GM 31.5% (B, C9-S015); ASI claims 37% (C, WS16-S026); tariffs compressing (B, C9-S015). Conservative -4 pts for newcomer pricing.
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: As above, first orders priced to win.
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Card processing on ~half of revenue (~1.5%), unrecovered freight, reprints/misprints (~1-2%); commonsku shop fee 2.5%->1% on store sales (B, DH-S021).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Spec samples, mockups, site visits, lunch-and-learns.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: LinkedIn/CRM data, website, sample library refresh, association event fees.
drivers.dso_days__source: Net-30 contractor AP with slow payers; ASI 2023 reports terms 'sometimes 120 days' (C, DH-S028); deposits on first orders offset.
drivers.inventory_days_cogs__source: Made to order, no inventory (C, WS16-S026); small sample and company-store buffer stock.
drivers.dpo_days__source: SanMar Net 30 only after credit approval incl. personal guaranty, else credit card (B, DH-S024); many suppliers prepay until credit established.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Covers samples, PPAI, laptop, insurance and receivable float.
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Small founder-dependent distributors; SDE-type multiple (D, not researched in detail).

staff.role: Account coordinator (order entry, proofs, supplier follow-up, store admin)

ASI 2023 median comp $75k (C, DH-S028); modelled as fixed loaded cost (E).

transactions.name: T1 - New-account crew kit, 40-person electrical subcontractor (60 hi-vis tees, 30 embroidered hoodies, 60 embroidered caps)

lines.item: Blanks + decoration from supplier/contract decorator (~67% of sell)

transactions.notes: Sell prices: hi-vis tee $18 (4imprint range $19.25-$32.75), hoodie $38, cap $16 (4imprint embroidered caps $6.75-$39.75) + $60 screens + $45 freight billed. Contract decoration benchmark $3.33/pc at 12 pcs, $20/screen (B, DH-S030). Contribution ~$926 (28%). Paid 50% deposit, balance net-30.

transactions.name: T2 - Construction Safety Week recognition order (150 laser-engraved 18-oz tumblers + 150 safety tees)
transactions.notes: Tumbler $14 (4imprint laser-engraved 18-oz $12.85-$21.35), tee $12. Contribution ~$1,215 (31%). Net-30 invoice; supplier paid by card at order -> ~45-day float gap.

transactions.name: T3 - Monthly company-store replenishment, 120-employee mechanical contractor
transactions.notes: Recurring program; contribution ~$500/month (25%). Store fee schedule (B, DH-S021).
